{# Nav tree for the generated JS reference sections, mirroring source directory structure. `top_tree` renders the root: every top-level node is always a section (see `forceTopLevelSections` in js_api_extract.js) tagged with `extra.weight`/`extra.group` (Zola doesn't expose front matter `weight` on `Section` to templates, so it's nested under `extra` instead), so it's split into "Core"/"Languages" headings, sorted by weight (Core-then-Workflows-then-alphabetical within Core; alphabetical within Languages). `tree` handles everything below that: collapsed except for the branch containing the current page. #} {% macro top_tree(section, active_set, current_relpath) %} {% set_global __subs = [] %} {% for sub_path in section.subsections %} {% set_global __subs = __subs | concat(with=[get_section(path=sub_path)]) %} {% endfor %} {% set sorted = __subs | sort(attribute="extra.weight") %} {% set_global __prev_group = "" %} {% for sub in sorted %} {% if sub.extra.group != __prev_group %} {% if not loop.first %}{% endif %}
{{ sub.extra.group | capitalize }}
    {% set_global __prev_group = sub.extra.group %} {% endif %}

    {% for page in section.pages | sort(attribute="title") %}
